findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/Group/Profinite/Basic.lean:52` explicitly proves `Subgroup.map_topologicalClosure_quotient_eq` while omitting `[CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]`; the current extra assumptions enter only through use of the stronger iff at line 168.
findings.fix: Move this theorem to a section requiring only `[Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]`, proving the image generates via `topologicalClosure_closure_image_eq_top` and discreteness of the open quotient.
findings.issue: `rank_quotient_le_card_of_topologicalClosure_closure_eq_top` inherits unused `[CompactSpace G]` and `[TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]`; density surjects onto any quotient by an open normal subgroup without either assumption.

summary: The finite-quotient rank bound is unnecessarily restricted to profinite groups even though its forward argument works for every topological group.
